overrule.translation: vt. 统治, 威压, 打败, 驳回\n[法] 否决, 驳回, 批驳

examples.en: Tom's stomach seems to overrule him at every turn.
The judge overruled the objection.
I'm also in favour so it's three to one. And thus your objection is overruled.

wnsyn.desc: rule against

oar.definition: n. an implement used to propel or steer a boat
oar.translation: n. 桨, 桨手, 搅棒\nvi. 划桨\nvt. 划动

examples.en: This boat has six oars.
examples.zh: 这艘船有六个桨。

odour.definition: n the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form\nn any property detected by the olfactory system
odour.translation: n. 气味, 臭气, 香气, 味道, 迹象, 名誉, 声誉\n[医] 气味

examples.en: This kind of odour is really terrifying.
examples.zh: 这种气味真可怕。

offence.definition:
n the action of attacking an enemy
n the team that has the ball (or puck) and is trying to score
n a feeling of anger caused by being offended
n a lack of politeness; a failure to show regard for others; wounding the feelings or others
n (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
offence.translation: n. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 罪过, 过错, 攻击\n[法] 犯法, 罪过, 过错

examples.en: She took offence at my word.
examples.zh: 她被我的话给激怒了。

ohm.definition: n. a unit of electrical resistance equal to the resistance between two points on a conductor when a potential difference of one volt between them produces a current of one ampere\nn. German physicist who formulated Ohm's law (1787-1854)

examples.en: The ohm is the unit of measure for electrical resistance.
The ohm is the unit of measurement for electrical resistance in the SI system. Its symbol is Ω.

wnsyn.desc: German physicist who formulated Ohm's law (1787-1854)

oil.definition: n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water\nn. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist\nv. cover with oil, as if by rubbing
oil.translation: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料\nvt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于\nvi. 加燃油, 融化

examples.en: All the oil in the lamp has been used.
examples.zh: 灯里的油用完了。

examples.en: We are not short of oil in this country.
examples.zh: 我们国家不缺石油。

examples.en: When are you finally going to oil your door?
examples.zh: 你什么时候才要给门上油?

wnsyn.desc: oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist

okay.definition: r. in a satisfactory or adequate manner; (`alright' is a nonstandard variant of `all right')
okay.translation:
a. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好
adv. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好
n. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可
vt. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可

examples.en: Why is it not okay if it's your sister?
examples.zh: 为什么你姐姐不好？

examples.en: What tea do you drink? Is lemon tea okay?
examples.zh: 你要喝什么茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？

examples.en: With you by my side, everything is okay now.
examples.zh: 你在我旁边，现在一切都好了。

wnsyn.desc: in a satisfactory or adequate manner

oneself.definition: pron. A reflexive form of the indefinite pronoun one.\n   Commonly writen as two words, one's self.

examples.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
examples.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

examples.en: Nowadays it's not possible to protect oneself against weapons of mass destruction.
examples.zh: 如今要保护自己不受大规模杀伤性武器的伤害是不可能的。

examples.en: It is presently very difficult to calm down and treat oneself with a book.
examples.zh: 现在很难静下心来好好看一本书。

onto.definition: prep. On the top of; upon; on. See On to, under On, prep.

examples.en: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
examples.zh: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。

examples.en: Grabbing onto his head, he said: "What is that?"
examples.zh: 他抓著头皮说：「那是什么？」

examples.en: He is just passing the blame onto others.
examples.zh: 他光是嫁祸于人家。

onward.definition: r forward in time or order or degree\nr in a forward direction
onward.translation: a. 向前的, 前进的\nadv. 向前, 前进, 在先

examples.en: From that day onward, Saul considered David his enemy.
From this point onward outdoor footwear is prohibited.
Time is a relentless river, flowing onward.
I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.
examples.zh: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。

examples.en: From November onwards, it gets colder.
examples.zh: 到了十一月，天就开始逐渐变凉了。

examples.en: No, if you do not start practising from now onwards, it would be too late.
examples.zh: 不，如果不从现在开始练习，就来不及了 。

operational.definition: a. pertaining to a process or series of actions for achieving a result\na. (military) of or intended for or involved in military operations\ns. being in effect or operation
operational.translation: a. 操作的, 运作的\n[法] 操作上的, 业务上的, 可起作用的

examples.en: Lukas’s plan will be operational by the time he returns.
When will be the El Hamdania seaport operational?
Can you work on improving operational efficiency?

wnsyn.desc: being in effect or operation

opium.definition: n. an addictive narcotic extracted from seed capsules of the opium poppy
opium.translation: n. 鸦片\n[化] 阿片; 鸦片

examples.en: Religion is the opium of the people.
examples.zh: 宗教是人民的鸦片。

optics.definition: n. the branch of physics that studies the physical properties of light\nn. optical properties

examples.en: Damiano began lecturing on the subject of optics.
His study of optics led him to the invention of the magnifying glass.
Music is the arithmetic of sounds as optics is the geometry of light.

orchard.definition: n garden consisting of a small cultivated wood without undergrowth

examples.en: I delight in going to the apple orchard each fall.
examples.zh: 我乐意每年秋季去苹果园。

examples.en: They stole apples from my orchard.
examples.zh: 他们从我的果园偷了苹果。

orderly.definition: n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer\nn. a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients\na. devoid of violence or disruption
orderly.translation: a. 有秩序的, 整齐的, 值班的\nn. 护理员, 清道夫, 传令兵, 勤务兵\nadv. 依次地, 顺序地

examples.en: In Japan, you can see the orderly lines at stations.
Spices and condiments should be arranged in an orderly manner.
When Tom was young, he was orderly and proper.

wnsyn.desc: a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients

ordinarily.translation: adv. 通常, 普通, 一般地

examples.en: Ordinarily, urban planners do not view pedestrians as important traffic.
I am able to use even cheap things ordinarily.
Ordinarily, Tom will eat lunch at the school cafeteria.

oriental.definition: n. a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)\ns. denoting or characteristic of countries of Asia
oriental.translation: n. 东方人, 亚洲人\na. 东方诸国的, 亚洲的, 东方的

examples.en: The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
examples.zh: 那篇关于佛教的文章再次勾起了我对东方宗教的兴趣。

examples.en: I have an interest in oriental ceramics.
examples.zh: 我对东方陶瓷有兴趣。

examples.en: It's a slow Oriental rhythm.
examples.zh: 这是舒缓的东方节奏。

ornamental.definition: n. any plant grown for its beauty or ornamental value
ornamental.translation: n. 装饰物, 观赏植物\na. 装饰性的, 装饰的, 观赏用的

examples.en: Heather is a very popular ornamental plant in gardens.
Some Africans wear ornamental scars to identify their tribes.
Male Bowerbirds build fascinating ornamental structures called "bowers" to attract mates.

ounce.definition: n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a pound\nn. a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound or 16 drams or 28.349 grams
ounce.translation: n. 盎司, 少量, 雪豹\n[医] 英两, Г

examples.en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
examples.zh: 预防胜于治疗。

examples.en: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
examples.zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。

wnsyn.desc: a unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a troy pound
a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound or 16 drams or 28.349 grams

outcry.definition: n a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition\nv shout louder than\nv utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
outcry.translation: n. 尖叫, 倒彩, 强烈抗议, 喊价\nvi. 喊叫\nvt. 叫得比...响

examples.en: The sinking of the RMS Lusitania caused an international outcry.
To address the public outcry, the president held a press conference.
The outcries of the angels go unheard by ordinary human ears.

outermost.definition: s. situated at the farthest possible point from a center
outermost.translation: a. 最外面的, 最远离中心的

examples.en: The exosphere is the outermost layer of our atmosphere.
The Sun's corona is the outermost part of the Sun's atmosphere.

wnsyn.desc: situated at the farthest possible point from a center

examples.en: His body type is born balanced! Wide shoulders, slim waist, belly not popping outwards.
examples.zh: 他的体形生得很匀称！肩膀宽，腰身窄，肚子又没凸出来。

oval.definition: n a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it\ns rounded like an egg
oval.translation: n. 椭圆形\na. 卵形的, 椭圆形的

examples.en: She has an oval face.
examples.zh: 她有一张椭圆形的脸。

overcoat.definition: n. an additional protective coating (as of paint or varnish)

examples.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
examples.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但那小孩也没有穿外套。

examples.en: In winter I wear an overcoat.
examples.zh: 冬天我穿一件大衣。

examples.en: He took off his overcoat.
examples.zh: 他脱掉了大衣。

wnsyn.desc: an additional protective coating (as of paint or varnish)

overestimate.definition: n. an appraisal that is too high\nn. a calculation that results in an estimate that is too high\nv. make too high an estimate of
overestimate.translation: vt. 评价过高, 过高估价\nn. 估计过高, 评价过高

examples.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.
examples.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。

wnsyn.desc: a calculation that results in an estimate that is too high
an appraisal that is too high
make too high an estimate of

overhang.definition: n. projection that extends beyond or hangs over something else\nv. project over\nv. be suspended over or hang over
overhang.translation: n. 突出部份, 悬垂部份\nvt. 悬于...之上, (危险等)逼近\nvi. 悬垂, 逼近

examples.en: When the rain started, she ducked under an overhang.
Just as Tom looked up, an icicle fell from overhang of roof.
The boughs of the large tree overhung the pond.

wnsyn.desc: be suspended over or hang over

overload.definition:
n. an electrical load that exceeds the available electrical power
n. an excessive burden
v. become overloaded
v. place too much a load on
overload.translation: vt. 超载, 过载, 超过负荷\nn. 超载, 负荷过多

examples.en: The fridge is overloaded with condiments.
examples.zh: 冰箱装满了调味品。

wnsyn.desc: place too much a load on
an excessive burden

owner.definition: n. (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business\nn. a person who owns something
owner.translation: n. 拥有者, 物主, 所有人\n[经] 所有者, 物主, 业主

examples.en: Who does the car belong to when the owner dies?
examples.zh: 主人死后车子归谁呢？

examples.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
examples.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

examples.en: Assets have earning power or some other value to their owner.
examples.zh: 资产盈利能力或一些其他的价值，它们的主人。

wnsyn.desc: (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business
a person who owns something

ox.definition: n. an adult castrated bull of the genus Bos; especially Bos taurus\nn. any of various wild bovines especially of the genera Bos or closely related Bibos

examples.en: What is permitted to Jove is not permitted to an ox.
examples.zh: 朱庇特能做的，公牛做不得。

examples.en: When the cow flies high and the ox flies low, there probably is a twister.
examples.zh: 当母牛飞得高, 公牛飞得低, 就有可能是一个龙卷风。

wnsyn.desc: any of various wild bovines especially of the genera Bos or closely related Bibos

oxidize.definition: v. add oxygen to or combine with oxygen
oxidize.translation: vt. 使氧化, 使生锈\nvi. 氧化

examples.en: As it oxidizes, the color turns blue and finally becomes a brilliant reddish-purple hue.
examples.zh: 随氧化变成蓝色，最终呈现出鲜艳的红紫色。

wnsyn.desc: add oxygen to or combine with oxygen
